purpose: Bind calls to authored Workflow occurrences and exact checked Operation action definitions without executing them or inventing domain relationships.
inputs: Separate ordinary named TypedType inputs from explicitly named Event-construction inputs qualified by their Event selector. Parameter names are unique across both spaces. Event envelopes are opaque whole inputs, not domain records or Operation success values.
calls: Exactly one binding per source step and compensation. Each pins action_sha256 for the Operation selected by that source occurrence. The provided registered action set exactly covers distinct orchestrates targets. All actions share the checked graph, composition boundary and exact field compilation.
arguments: Exact Operation ordinary parameter coverage and exact TypedType equality. Expressions are explicit input or step-result paths, checked existing literal or variant expressions, and explicit list-to-set conversion. Property paths use ontology property identities. No implicit query, calculation, mapping, optional traversal or effect is performed.
events: Exact Operation Event parameter coverage. Each binds one declared Workflow Event input with the same qualified Event target. The checked artifact carries the source-bound Event constructor schema, including occurrence identity, payload and required or generated time. It does not coerce Event primitives into the domain TypedType vocabulary.
availability: A forward call can read ordinary Workflow inputs and results of strictly earlier source steps. A compensation can read ordinary inputs and results from the source prefix ending at its own for_step. This is the prefix guaranteed whenever its own step completed. No forward call reads itself, later results or compensation results. Dependencies between compensations are not value bindings or execution.
result: A declared TypedType and expression checked against all forward success values. No failed or indeterminate Operation outcome is treated as a successful value.
identity: Step and compensation names, qualified Operation and Event selectors, action hashes, ontology property names and parameter names retain their separate meanings. Repeated Operations remain distinct calls and cannot address results by Operation selector.
ownership: Closed bounded inert ordinary JSON is decoded before field access, copied and frozen. Only registered checked graph, boundary, field and action objects are accepted. Returned bindings bind exact source and definition bytes and are separately registered. No arbitrary Proxy isolation is claimed.
compatibility: Additive explicit compiler binding artifact only. The authored Workflow occurrence v1 source, legacy Workflow behavior, Operation bindings and existing source selections remain unchanged.
